note: Semantics for every frozen relation name of context-map-1 (since 1.1; 1.2 appends network_member). Domain and range are class ids from classes.json (a class admits its subclasses) or pseudo-classes: @scope (site, plant, unit, system), @connector (off-page connector, boundary), @loop, @network (since 1.2), @any. A link is checked only when both ends have a certified class; an end with no class is not checked and is counted. A link outside its domain or range is never dropped: it becomes a review row ('link doesn't fit what it connects'). Cardinality is the expected count per from-end and per to-end (0..1, 1, 0..*, 1..*); an upper bound of 1 exceeded is a review row, a lower bound is an expectation rule's job.

pseudo_classes.@scope: a site, plant, unit or system scope
pseudo_classes.@connector: an off-page connector or boundary item
pseudo_classes.@network: a recorded line network (an item of kind line_network); since 1.2

relations.name: contains
relations.note: Each item or scope has exactly one parent (per_to 1).

relations.name: piped_to
relations.means: consecutive process items on a pipe run
relations.note: Not transitive: a path of piped_to links is a route, not one pipe run. In-line meters (transmitters and primary elements) may sit on the pipe.

relations.name: measures
relations.note: An instrument senses one item; an item may have many instruments.

relations.name: controls
relations.note: A pump or other drive is a final element when a controller sets its speed.

relations.name: sets_point_of
relations.note: An inner controller takes its set point from one master.

relations.name: acts_on
relations.means: what a valve or actuator changes

relations.name: protects
relations.note: A relief device protects at least one item (the expectation rule R-RELIEF-PROTECTS checks it).

relations.name: signal_to
relations.means: a signal line on the P&ID
relations.note: A signal ends at an instrument function, a valve actuator or a drive (a pump speed).

relations.name: references
relations.means: where a connector or boundary leads

relations.name: mentions
relations.means: a tag or glossary term found in a document's text

relations.name: based_on
relations.means: the basis a document was written from
relations.note: Transitive: a revision reopens everything based on it, directly or not.

relations.name: network_member
relations.means: on the same recorded line network; not pipe adjacency, not flow
relations.note: Since 1.2. Item -> item: both ends are on one recorded network (a drawn line network, or a reader's run between tagged ends through untagged in-line valves and fittings); tees and in-line items may sit between them. Item -> line network: the item is on that network. Never read as piped_to (consecutive items on a pipe run) and never as a flow direction. Same meaning as engineering-context-basis-1 network_member.

twin_graph_2_edges_note: How one_map.py's twin-graph-2 edge types read as context-map relations, for the same checks. twin-graph-1 uses `controls` for both measurement -> controller and controller -> final element; the first is read as signal_to. Since 1.2 `connects` reads as network_member (a run between tagged ends is network co-membership, not pipe adjacency; it read as piped_to in 1.1, which was wrong). The relation checks read this flat table; scripts/context_map.py also reads twin_graph_2_edges_by_layer, which wins where an edge's layer is listed.
twin_graph_1_edges_note: Since 1.2. How graph_export.py's twin-graph-1 edge types read as context-map relations (scripts/context_map.py). null = kept out of the map, with the reason in twin_graph_1_not_mapped; a converter keeps such edges verbatim beside the map, never drops them silently. `connects` is read by its layer (graph_export.py CONNECTS_LAYERS). A `controls` edge from a measurement reads as signal_to (controls_from_measurement_reads_as).

twin_graph_1_not_mapped.connects/stream: a hand-built model's logical process stream between declared endpoints; context-map-1 has no logical-stream relation, and piped_to or network_member would claim drawn line work the model does not have
twin_graph_1_not_mapped.sits_on: an item on a logical stream; the stream is not an item of the map
twin_graph_1_not_mapped.trips: measurement to interlock; interlocks belong in the interlock_list register, not the PLANT layer
twin_graph_1_not_mapped.applies_to: limit to its tag; limits belong in the operating_limit register, not the PLANT layer
twin_graph_1_not_mapped.instrument_connection: a drawn instrument line (a bubble's leader or impulse line); the drawing does not say whether it measures, signals or only labels, so no relation is claimed

engineering_context_basis_1_relations_no: Since 1.2. How scripts/context_basis.py RELATIONS predicates read as context-map relations. null = no PLANT relation: the basis keeps it as its own claim. A predicate in engineering_context_basis_1_reversed reads with its ends swapped: 'FIC-101 reads FT-101' is FT-101 signal_to FIC-101.

engineering_context_basis_1_not_mapped.associated_with: a declared association with no physical or control meaning; no context-map relation says that little
engineering_context_basis_1_not_mapped.reported_installation_at: a record linking an observed physical item to a position; that is a maintenance_export row (RECORDS layer), not a PLANT relation
